note: Salesforce Logger writes Salesforce suite events to Drupal's logger at a configurable threshold. Its whole surface is the salesforce_logger.settings config object: log_level (salesforce.error | salesforce.warning | salesforce.notice), log_push_success (bool), log_push_params (bool), log_push_params_maxlength, log_push_params_sanitized_fields. No connection needed - all medium/hard cases are grounded in that local config, verified by pure reads. Cleanup restores shipped defaults (log_level salesforce.error, log_push_success false).

evals.prompt: In the Salesforce Logger module, what config controls how much Salesforce logging happens, and what are the possible log levels?
evals.expected_output: salesforce_logger.settings.log_level sets the minimum severity: salesforce.error (errors only), salesforce.warning (warnings and errors), or salesforce.notice (all Salesforce events).

evals.prompt: The Salesforce Logger can log the data sent to Salesforce on push, which may be sensitive. Which settings control logging the push params, truncating them, and redacting fields?
evals.expected_output: log_push_params logs the params sent on push; log_push_params_maxlength truncates them; log_push_params_sanitized_fields lists fields to redact; log_push_success additionally logs successful pushes.

evals.prompt: By default, what does Salesforce Logger log - all events or just errors? And where does it send them?
evals.expected_output: By default log_level is salesforce.error, so only errors are logged. Events are written to Drupal's logging system (watchdog/dblog).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, at what level is Salesforce Logger configured to log? Inspect the live configuration and give the log_level value.
evals.expected_output: The log level is salesforce.warning (log warnings and errors): salesforce_logger.settings log_level = salesforce.warning.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is Salesforce Logger configured to also log successful pushes to Salesforce (not just failures)? Inspect the live configuration and say yes or no.
evals.expected_output: Yes: salesforce_logger.settings log_push_success is true, so successful pushes are logged as well.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Salesforce Logger to log ALL Salesforce events (the most verbose level) so you can debug an integration. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: salesforce_logger.settings log_level is set to salesforce.notice ('Log all salesforce events').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Salesforce Logger to also log successful pushes to Salesforce, not only failures. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: salesforce_logger.settings log_push_success is set to true.
